title: Google Analytics Tools & Solutions for your Business - Analytics

facts.fact: The page states that multiple campaigns can be created within the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: The page lists Google Analytics under a 'No-cost solutions' heading alongside Merchant Center and Google Business Profile.
The page offers users the option to create a free Google Analytics account.
Gymshark, a UK fitness apparel brand, used Google Analytics reports to help reduce checkout drop-offs by 9%, according to Google's case study on the page.
facts.quote: Gymshark, a UK fitness apparel and accessories brand, uncovered fresh insights and key pain points from the Google Analytics User Explorer report and other ecommerce reports to help reduce checkout drop-offs by 9%.

facts.fact: 412 Food Rescue, a US non-profit, cut its reporting time by 50% after gaining full visibility into the user journey and campaign metrics with Google Analytics, per Google's case study.
facts.quote: 412 Food Rescue cuts reporting time by 50%.

facts.fact: Bayer, a global pharmaceuticals company, doubled its high-value conversions to 39% within 3 months using Google Analytics and AI-supported value-based bidding, per Google's case study.
facts.quote: Bayer, a global pharmaceuticals company, doubled the number of high-value conversions to 39% within 3 months by using Google Analytics

facts.fact: Google states that performance statistics are specific to the individual advertiser and individual results may vary.
facts.quote: Performance statistics are specific to this advertiser and individual results may vary.

facts.fact: Google's page lists integrations with Google Ads, Google Search Console, Google Play, Google Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Reddit, Snap Ads, Meta, and Pinterest.
